question: Who among the following won the 'Indian Personality of the Year Award' during the 51st International Film Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biswajit Chatterjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biswajit Chatterjee **__won the 'Indian Personality of the Year Award' during the 51st International Film Festival.
 
• He is a veteran actor, producer, director and singer of Hindi and Bengali cinema.
 
• He is known for his roles of Kumar Vijay Singh in Bees Saal Baad, Raja Amit Kumar Singh in musical drama Kohra, etc.
 
• The 51st International Film Festival of India was held from 16 to 24 January 2021 in Goa.
 
• Some of the winners of awards-
 
 
• Golden Peacock Award: Into the Darkness
 
• Best Debut Director Award: Cássio Pereira dos Santos, Valentina
 
• ICFT UNESCO Gandhi Award: Ameen Nayfeh’s 200 Meters
 
• Lifetime Achievement Award: Vittorio Storaro
 
• IFFI Best Actor Award (Male): Tzu-Chuan Liu, film Silent Forest
 
• IFFI Best Actor Award (Female): Zofia Stafiej for Polish film I Never Cry
